changes: Name re-read as 'Bhājudhana'. The rest of Bendall's '-mṛcay-āviyā' is probably a misreading of the Newari ergative plus verb 'na coyāviyā' ('written by'), not part of the name. Confidence stays low.
Residence removed: Kāntipur is given as the place of writing, not as the scribe's residence.
Notes expanded with the reasoning for the name.

persons.name: Bhājudhana
persons.evidence: written in the year given above by Ṣrīvajrācārya Bhājudhanamṛcay-āviyā (?) at Kāntipur

notes: Bendall does not quote the vernacular (Newari) colophon. He only paraphrases it: 'written in the year given above by Ṣrīvajrācārya Bhājudhanamṛcay-āviyā (?) at Kāntipur (Kathmandu).' He marks the name as doubtful. The ending '-mṛcay-āviyā' is very likely a misreading of Newari '-na coyāviyā' (ergative -na + coyā biyā, 'written by'). On that reading the name is Bhājudhana ('Bhāju' may be the Newari honorific 'Bhāju' + Dhana). The date NS 905 = 1785 CE (NS+880) matches Bendall's conversion. No month or tithi is reported.
